title: God as Shepherd
definition: God as Shepherd means that He guides, protects, provides for, corrects, and cares for His people.
summary: The Lord does not abandon His sheep. He leads them, restores them, and keeps them by His care.
christFocus: Jesus is the Good Shepherd who lays down His life for the sheep.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Lord does not abandon His sheep. He leads them, restores them, and keeps them by His care.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
